notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (EY). Thousand Baht. SCI p.5. Note 6 total columns give revenue (p.45) and expenses (p.46; incurred claims include PAA). The insurance-contract notes are split by product group: 7 non-participating, 8 participating (indirect), 9 universal life, 10 participating (direct) / unit-linked. CSM roll-forward = sum of the CSM columns of 7.2 + 8.2 + 9.2 + 10.2 (p.51, 56, 61, 65; 3 months); new business = 7.3 + 8.3 + 10.3 (p.53, 58, 67; universal life wrote none). Each summed item records the group 7 page. In this edition the roll-forward prints the balances with their own sign but every movement with the profit-or-loss sign (the CSM release positive, new business and finance negative), so the movement rules carry sign -1 (the 2026 interims print movements with the balance sign). Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM columns). Accretion = the profit-or-loss part of the insurance-finance row (CSM column; '-' for group 10). Other revenue = รายการอื่น. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
